title: High scores
description:
Keep a top-10 high score table and save it to a file.

```
add Ada 1200 -> place 1
add Bob 900  -> place 2
add Cy 50 with a full table of better scores -> not on the table
saved 10 lines to scores.txt, loaded back the same
```
hints: As in lesson 6.01, `std::find_if` with `[&](const Score& t) { return points > t.points; }` finds the first worse score; inserting there puts equal scores after the existing ones. The place is that position's index plus 1.
After inserting, `if (m_scores.size() > 10) m_scores.pop_back();` and check whether the new one survived.
requirements: Scores are sorted highest first; equal scores keep the earlier one higher.
At most 10 entries; `add` returns the place or nothing.
Save as `name score` lines and load them back, skipping bad lines.
stretch: Save to the user's save folder instead of next to the game.
